items.title: How Much Of KLA Stock's Rise Did The Business Earn?
items.summary: KLA Corporation sells process control tools, machines that check chips for flaws while they are made. Its stock rose 301% from the close of September 30, 2021 to the close of Wednesday, November 25, 2026, before dividends. It is natural to credit the business for all of it. Take a guess: how much of the rise came from KLA simply selling more.

items.title: ASML Sinks 6% in Chip Rout as Dutch Lawmaker Warns MATCH Act Is “Disastrous for ASML”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysASML fell 6% today, along with Applied Materials, Lam Research and KLA, as Dutch lawmakers warned against a US bill aimed at its China sales. The MATCH Act would push the Netherlands to tighten curbs on ASML’s immersion DUV tools or face US restrictions.
